title: What bird am I? Free bird personality quiz — cv.cm
description: Free bird quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're an owl, eagle, parrot, swan, crow, hummingbird, penguin or flamingo, and what your bird says about you. No sign-up.
lede: A wise night owl, a chatty parrot or a busy hummingbird? Answer 12 questions about your habits, your friends and your style to find the bird that matches your personality.
about: Birds have stood for human qualities in stories for thousands of years: the owl for wisdom, the eagle for vision and power, the swan for grace. Some of those images even match what scientists have found. Crows really are among the cleverest animals and can remember human faces for years, hummingbirds beat their wings dozens of times a second, and flamingos live and even dance in big, noisy flocks. This quiz uses those well-known traits to match your personality with one of eight birds.

Your result names your bird, explains what it says about you and shows your scores for all eight. It's a fun quiz written for cv.cm, not a scientific test. If you like it, try the spirit animal quiz too.

faq.a: Owl, eagle, parrot, swan, crow, hummingbird, penguin and flamingo.

faq.q: Is one bird rarer than the others?
faq.a: Every bird appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

faq.q: How is this different from the spirit animal quiz?
faq.a: This one is only about birds and their best-known traits. The spirit animal quiz covers mammals, birds and sea animals.

faq.q: Is this a scientific personality test?
faq.a: No. It's a fun quiz written for cv.cm, and your answers stay in your browser.

owl.name: Owl
owl.body: You're wise, observant and thoughtful. You notice what others miss, you think before you speak and you probably do your best thinking late at night. People come to you for advice because you listen and see clearly.

eagle.name: Eagle
eagle.body: You're ambitious, focused and independent. You see the big picture, set high goals and go after them with determination. You're a natural leader; just make sure you come down to earth sometimes to share the view with others.

parrot.name: Parrot
parrot.body: You're social, funny and full of chatter. You love people, conversation and a good laugh, and you pick up new words, accents and jokes in no time. Your friends never get bored around you.

swan.name: Swan
swan.body: You're graceful, calm and deeply loyal. You glide through life with poise, and you're fiercely protective of the people you love. Under that calm surface you work harder than people realize.

crow.name: Crow
crow.body: You're clever, curious and resourceful. You love puzzles, new tools and figuring things out, and you remember everything, kindness and slights alike. People underestimate you at first, but never twice.

hummingbird.name: Hummingbird
hummingbird.body: You're energetic, quick and always on the move. You find joy everywhere, you juggle many interests and you're small but mighty. Remember to pause and refuel; even hummingbirds need rest.

penguin.name: Penguin
penguin.body: You're loyal, warm and a true team player. You stick with your people through the coldest days, and you're happiest when everyone's together. You might feel a little awkward sometimes, but that only makes you more lovable.

flamingo.name: Flamingo
flamingo.body: You're bold, stylish and social. You stand out in any crowd, you love being part of a lively group and you bring color to everything. Confidence suits you; keep balancing it with kindness.
